texts.LogicModels_Builder_ActionFailed: The logic model was not saved. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.LogicModels_Builder_ArrowExists: That arrow is already there. Change its assumption instead.
texts.LogicModels_Builder_BackwardArrows: That column would make these arrows point backward: {0}. Delete those arrows first, or pick a column that keeps every arrow pointing forward.
texts.LogicModels_Builder_LookAtNone: Nothing to look at: every part is linked and every outcome is measured.
texts.LogicModels_Builder_NotFound: This logic model, or the part you changed, can no longer be found. Reload the page.
texts.LogicModels_Builder_PeriodExists: This indicator already has a period with these dates. Change that row instead.
texts.LogicModels_Builder_SelectHint: Select a part to change it, link it or measure it.
texts.LogicModels_Drag_ArrowDropped: Arrow from {0} to {1}: add its assumption, then save.
texts.LogicModels_Drag_ArrowInstructions: To draw an arrow, press Space, use the Left and Right arrow keys to pick a later part, then press Space again. Escape cancels.
texts.LogicModels_Drag_ArrowPickedUp: Drawing an arrow from {0}. Use the Left and Right arrow keys to pick the part it leads to, then press Space. Escape cancels.
texts.LogicModels_Drag_Hint: Drag a part by its handle to reorder it or move it to another column, or drag its arrow handle onto a later part to link them. Edit, Move Up, Move Down and Add Arrow still work.
texts.LogicModels_Evidence_None: No evidence recorded for this assumption yet. Add a study, an evaluation, a survey or what staff have seen.
texts.LogicModels_Evidence_RemoveConfirm: Remove this evidence? The assumption itself stays.
texts.LogicModels_Indicator_DeleteConfirm: Delete this indicator and its periods?
texts.LogicModels_Part_DeleteConfirm: Delete this part? Its arrows, and its indicators with their periods, are deleted too.
texts.LogicModels_Part_NoTargets: No later part to link to yet. Add one in a column to the right.
texts.LogicModels_Part_RemoveArrowConfirm: Remove the arrow from {0} to {1}? Its assumption is deleted too.
texts.LogicModels_Period_DeleteConfirm: Delete the period {0} with its target and result?
texts.LogicModels_Periods_Added: Indicators given this period: {0}. Indicators that already had these dates keep their own.
texts.LogicModels_Periods_DeleteConfirm: Remove {0} from the model's reporting periods? Periods already on indicators stay, with their targets and results.
texts.LogicModels_Periods_EndBeforeStart: {0} ends before it starts. Check its dates.
texts.LogicModels_Periods_Intro: Periods every indicator can share. Add one to every indicator at once, or give one indicator all of them with Use the Model's Periods. Indicators keep their own periods too.
texts.LogicModels_Periods_Invalid: Give each reporting period a name, a start date and an end date.
texts.LogicModels_Periods_SameDates: {0} has the same dates as another reporting period. Change its dates or remove one.
texts.LogicModels_Periods_TooMany: A model can have at most {0} reporting periods. Remove some before adding more.
texts.LogicModels_Periods_UsedAdded: Periods added to this indicator: {0}. Periods it already had stay as they are.
texts.LogicModels_Report_ChooseOne: Choose at least one period to compare.
texts.LogicModels_Report_NoIndicators: This model has no indicators yet. Add them to outputs and outcomes in the builder.
texts.LogicModels_Report_NoPeriods: No indicator has a period yet. Add periods to compare them here.
texts.LogicModels_Report_PrintHelp: Download the PDF to send it as it is, or open the printable report in your browser to print it.
texts.LogicModels_Results_None: There are no periods to fill in: add periods, or every indicator is computed.
texts.LogicModels_Scope_BadProgram: Choose the program with Change in the Logic Model Builder. This is not a program.
texts.LogicModels_Scope_OrganizationTaken: The organization already has a logic model. Open that one instead of adding another.
texts.LogicModels_Scope_ProgramTaken: This program already has a logic model. Open that one instead of adding another.
texts.LogicModels_Source_CannotRefresh: You can't change results, so you can't refresh them.
texts.LogicModels_Source_DateField: {0} is not a date field. Choose a date or date and time field to place records in periods.
texts.LogicModels_Source_Invalid: Choose a source, and for Computed a saved query, a date field and what to work out.
texts.LogicModels_Source_NoQueries: No saved queries yet. Build and save one in Find first.
texts.LogicModels_Source_NotComputed: Only a computed indicator's results can be refreshed.
texts.LogicModels_Source_QueryHelp: Build and save the query in Find. Leave dates out of it: each period adds its own.
texts.LogicModels_Source_QueryMissing: The saved query can't be found. It may have been deleted or not shared with you: choose another under Source.
texts.LogicModels_Source_QueryRefused: The saved query can't be used: {0}
texts.LogicModels_Source_RefreshFailed: The results were not worked out. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.LogicModels_Source_ResultComputed: Worked out from the source, so it can't be typed.
texts.LogicModels_Source_StillWorking: The results are still being worked out. Select Check Again in a minute.
texts.LogicModels_Source_SumField: {0} is not a number field, so it can't be added up.
texts.LogicModels_Source_TooManyUnique: There are too many different values to count once. Narrow the saved query or count records instead.
texts.LogicModels_Source_UniqueField: {0} can't be counted once per value. Choose another field.
texts.LogicModels_Source_Working: Working out results. This takes a few minutes; this panel updates when it is done.
texts.LogicModels_Starter_ChooseRecord: Choose one of the records listed. The one chosen can no longer be found, or is not of the right kind.
texts.LogicModels_Starter_Help: Pick what to count and BarnCRM builds the saved query in Find for you, as your own private query. Choose Saved Query to use one you built.
texts.LogicModels_Starter_NoFind: You can't save queries in Find, so this indicator can't be built for you. Ask your BarnCRM admin, or choose Saved Query.
texts.LogicModels_Starter_Unavailable: That choice is not available in this org. Choose another, or choose Saved Query.
